streams.pump_role: Main feed for substrates, solvent, and heterogeneous catalyst
streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan specifies single stream A with all reagents. Flow rate derived from Analogy 1 (0.4 mL/min) and calculation target (0.5 mL/min) to achieve short residence time.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan states all components can be mixed simultaneously. Static mixer ensures homogeneity of heterogeneous catalyst Cu/C before heating.
pre_reactor_steps: Suspend Cu/C in acetone with substrates to ensure uniform catalyst distribution.
No deoxygenation required as per Chemistry Plan (CuAAC is air tolerant).
post_reactor_steps: Filtration or solid-liquid separator to remove heterogeneous Cu/C catalyst.
chemistry_notes: CuAAC reaction using heterogeneous Cu/C catalyst. Batch used microwave heating at 150°C for 3 min. Flow design uses thermal heating at 150°C. Analogy 1 (cross-coupling) supports high-temp flow operation with BPR. Calculation indicates mass-transfer limitation (Da >> 1), so static mixing is critical. Heterogeneous catalyst requires post-reaction separation. Acetone bp (56°C) requires BPR at 150°C.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2 suggests 0.3 min (18s) based on 12x intensification factor from batch 3 min. Analogy 1 used 10 min but for different kinetics; we follow calculation for kinetic acceleration.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single phase liquid system. Basis is liquid volume / liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (150°C) to ensure conversion. Analogy 1 used 170°C but 150°C is sufficient per batch data.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8 requires 11.8 bar to keep acetone liquid at 150°C. Set to 12 bar for safety margin.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA selected for chemical compatibility with acetone and thermal stability at 150°C. SS (Analogy 1) is also viable but PFA allows visual inspection and is standard for organic synthesis.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.25 M from Batch Protocol and Chemistry Plan. Analogy 1 used 0.65 M but we maintain batch concentration to avoid solubility issues with Cu/C suspension.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculated as V = Q * t = 0.5 mL/min * 0.3 min = 0.15 mL. This is a small volume; a short coil or microreactor chip is appropriate.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm from Analogy 1 and Calculation Step 3. Balances pressure drop and mixing efficiency.
